HOW I WORK

Start with the problem.
Stay for the details.

A few habits that connect my work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI.

01

Understand the whole path.

Follow the request from the interface through the API, data, and infrastructure. Good decisions account for the person using the result.

02

Make the trade-offs explicit.

Choose a managed service, relational model, or asynchronous workflow because it solves the actual constraint. Keep the architecture explainable.

03

Build for the next person.

Repeatable deployment, useful logs, clear boundaries, and documentation make a working prototype easier to maintain and hand over.
